services.name: Shingle consult
services.story: Shingle consult, $35; nothing taken; a YES books it; paid at the showroom desk.

services.name: Roof preview session

services.name: Full exterior plan

services.name: Metal roof plan
services.story: Metal roof plan, priced from Alex's photos and measurements at $90 (Sam OKs it); a card saved for the $20 fee; paid at the desk.

services.name: Tile roof match
services.story: Tile roof match, priced at the showroom once Hana sees the old tile: only the $25 consult is promised; a card saved; paid at the desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Diego and Owen (estimators and crew leads)

services.name: Roof repair
services.story: Storm-damaged roof: a repair priced at the visit (the $89 inspection fee is owed even after a no), nothing taken; Rosie texts the bill after. A bigger job, like Harper J.'s $2,400 porch roof, becomes its own job: a signed quote and stage payments.

services.name: Roof repair
services.story: The same repair priced at the visit, but Sam bills it the business's own way; Rosie sends nothing about money.

services.name: Roof repair
services.story: The same repair priced at the visit, with a card saved for the $89 inspection fee when Alex books.

services.name: Shingle repair
services.story: A $179 shingle repair from the list; a card saved for the $89 fee; Rosie texts the bill after the job.

services.name: Skylight
services.story: A skylight priced from photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it); a signed contract; a 25% deposit of $160; the rest on the bill.

services.name: Shingle repair
services.story: A $179 shingle repair for a returning customer: nothing taken; Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Moss treatment
services.story: A $150 moss treatment, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Moss treatment

Roof type: shingle, tile, metal or flat
About how old is the roof?
How many stories is the house?
safety_stop: a tree through the roof or a wall, power lines down on or near the house
a ceiling sagging, bulging or falling
a gas smell, sparking or smoking wires
license: if: a roofing license or registration for the company, where the state's form requires one (some states license roofing on its own, some under a contractor or home improvement license, some not at all)
